resources.string: Connecting the recorder — calls won\'t record until this finishes.
Locking the screen during a call may stop the recording. In Settings ▸ Experimental, set “USB when screen unlocks” to Charging only.
If this doesn\'t finish, set “USB when screen unlocks” to Charging only in Settings ▸ Experimental — on some phones a data USB mode stops the recorder from connecting.
Open the phone\'s \'Pair device with pairing code\' dialog.
Turn on Wireless debugging to start pairing.
Setting up CallVault. This takes a few seconds.
Wireless debugging paired. Tap to finish setting up CallVault.
Open the app and tap Update to install it.
The update could not be downloaded. Tap to get it from GitHub.
The downloaded update failed the security check and was discarded. Tap to get it from GitHub.
The update could not be installed. Tap to get it from GitHub.
USB debugging and Wireless debugging are both off. Turn one back on in Developer options.
USB debugging is off and there\'s no Wi-Fi. Connect to Wi-Fi, or turn USB debugging on.
The recorder keeps failing to start. Open CallVault to see why.
The recorder stopped and needs Wi-Fi to start again. Turning on Offline recording while on Wi-Fi avoids this.
You turned Wireless debugging off, and nothing else lets CallVault restart the recorder. Turn it back on, or turn on USB debugging.
Off-Wi-Fi recording is paused: it needs USB debugging. Calls on Wi-Fi still record.
